units.rawText: Who goes there? Might you be an old friend from the modern world? Forgive me, for I have sworn a geis and find it difficult to recall the past after lingering here for so long.
units.displayText: Who goes there? Might you be an old friend from the modern world? Forgive me, for I have sworn a geis and find it difficult to recall the past after lingering here for so long.

units.rawText: The modern world? Recalling the past?
units.displayText: The modern world? Recalling the past?

spans.text: The modern world? Recalling the past?

units.rawText: This agent in a Celtic outfit looks very suspicious.
units.displayText: This agent in a Celtic outfit looks very suspicious.

spans.text: This agent in a Celtic outfit looks very suspicious.

units.rawText: Indeed. I hope you have not yet forgotten like I have. If you lack clarity purely because I have not explained myself at length, I am willing to engage you in conversation and speak of things both old and new, like valiant warriors of the present.

units.rawText: Well, if you're willing to talk, can you tell me if anything of note happened around here?
units.displayText: Well, if you're willing to talk, can you tell me if anything of note happened around here?

spans.text: Well, if you're willing to talk, can you tell me if anything of note happened around here?

units.rawText: Anything of note, you say... A troop of odd looking, suspicious outsiders passed by here just now and headed deeper within.
units.displayText: Anything of note, you say... A troop of odd looking, suspicious outsiders passed by here just now and headed deeper within.

spans.text: Anything of note, you say... A troop of odd looking, suspicious outsiders passed by here just now and headed deeper within.

units.rawText: However, they were merely carrying crates loaded with the wealth of the modern world, which is not forbidden by the geis which binds me, and thus I permitted them to leave.
units.displayText: However, they were merely carrying crates loaded with the wealth of the modern world, which is not forbidden by the geis which binds me, and thus I permitted them to leave.

spans.text: However, they were merely carrying crates loaded with the wealth of the modern world, which is not forbidden by the geis which binds me, and thus I permitted them to leave.

units.rawText: "Odd looking, suspicious outsiders"... Could that be the combat team that went out just now?
units.displayText: "Odd looking, suspicious outsiders"... Could that be the combat team that went out just now?

spans.text: "Odd looking, suspicious outsiders"... Could that be the combat team that went out just now?

units.rawText: Oh, it's nothing. In any case, you won't intervene if something isn't covered by your geis, right?
units.displayText: Oh, it's nothing. In any case, you won't intervene if something isn't covered by your geis, right?

spans.text: Oh, it's nothing. In any case, you won't intervene if something isn't covered by your geis, right?

units.rawText: Indeed. I will not involve myself in matters that do not concern ancient relics, archaean creatures, or their progeny.
units.displayText: Indeed. I will not involve myself in matters that do not concern ancient relics, archaean creatures, or their progeny.

spans.text: Indeed. I will not involve myself in matters that do not concern ancient relics, archaean creatures, or their progeny.

units.rawText: The modern world operates by its own rules, and a guardian ought not to interfere with them.
units.displayText: The modern world operates by its own rules, and a guardian ought not to interfere with them.

spans.text: The modern world operates by its own rules, and a guardian ought not to interfere with them.

units.rawText: I see. I'd better tell the explorers not to touch the things she's guarding, then. Considering the huge amount of operands here, avoiding her might be the best course of action.

units.rawText: Hm? Did you mention something, perchance?

units.rawText: Not at all. Thank you for indulging me. I believe your upcoming vigil will go much more easily for you.
